{{Quote|Artoo, stay with the ship.|Darth Vader to R2-D2 on Mustafar|<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
This [[Color/Legends|green]] '''[[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]]''' was flown by the newly anointed [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] shortly before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Darth Vader flew this green-painted starfighter from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] after [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|apartment]], then to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to eliminate the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leaders. Due to Vader being dismembered during the [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|duel on Mustafar]] and unable to use it to leave the planet, its fate afterward remains unknown.
